description: knapcio's Inkling 2 Mini kit (v2.9.7, commit 09febfe1) on one Spark: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini (26.4B total, 3.4B active looped MoE; NVFP4 experts in layers 0-19, MXFP8 in 20-23, BF16 attention) on SGLang's published lmsysorg/sglang inkling-2-mini image (arm64 digest-pinned; the Vonk launcher, a non-root user and the kit's speed overlays baked in at /opt/inkling-overlay), tensor parallel 1, DFlash2 speculative decoding with IncoAI's drafter (incoai/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2, Apache-2.0, 1 GB, mounted at /models/draft; eight draft tokens, block verification, the kit's verify-width cap policy and prompt-copy drafts, prefix-tail deferral on and a shared verify settle), whose SGLang support file is applied at build time, the inkling reasoning and inkling2 tool-call parsers, xgrammar structured output and text input. The kit's defaults are mirrored: 262,144-token context, mem-fraction-static 0.88, swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.037, max-mamba-cache-size 512, max-prefill-tokens 8192, 48 running requests, and the packed global-layer KV store (KV12S=1, static pools), which upstream measured at 2,371,200 global-layer KV tokens on its box B. The kit's optional 1,048,576-token context (CTX) is selectable with the context setting. Memory: the declared peak is the creator's formula at its current worst case under DFlash2 (thinking c24 alongside a cold 240K-token prefill, results KV294-s06), where the lowest MemAvailable was 4.1 GiB, so 130,593,832,960 bytes of MemTotal less 4.1 GiB in use, less the 2 GiB OS allowance, 124,044,007,834 bytes; that run includes start-up, so no separate load peak is declared, and nothing else should share the Spark. It is an estimate until tried here: our earlier hardware run of the previous content measured a 125.4 GB peak. Interface adaptations: the checkpoint is mounted at /models, and the shared Inkling forced tool-call build patch is applied as for every Inkling SGLang recipe. Licences (information only): model Apache-2.0; SGLang Apache-2.0; knapcio's kit MIT with third-party notices in NOTICE.upstream.
title: Inkling 2 Mini NVFP4 DFlash2 SGLang single Spark (knapcio)
